programmes.evidence: The business curriculum labels its MA/Ph.D course field Management Decision Science. The official 2026 general-graduate admissions table independently lists 경영과학 (Management Science) as a named Business Administration doctoral field.
limitations: The 2026 Korean admissions field and older English curriculum field have different literal names; they are evidence of the same host area, not two separate doctorates.

branches.conclusion: The 2026 general-graduate admissions table explicitly lists Business Administration doctoral entry with 경영과학 (Management Science). Earlier official business pages identify the host hierarchy and Management Decision Science MA/Ph.D curriculum.

The 2026 general-graduate doctoral admissions table's science and engineering rows name mathematics, statistics, computing, electrical, materials, architecture, environment, human-machine biomedical, semiconductor and data-science fields, with no additional named Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering field. Smart Factory convergence is a different literal title and is not counted.

sources.note: Official 2026 general-graduate admissions PDF, 38 pages; relevant doctoral programme and field tables on pages 3–8 read 25 October 2026. Page 4 lists Business Administration doctorate and named 경영과학; pages 4–6 list science, engineering and interdisciplinary doctorate fields, none with another strict matching title. The remainder of the admissions PDF was not needed for field-inventory review.
Earlier official English MA/Ph.D curriculum names Management Decision Science.
Earlier complete engineering unit and degree-level frame, including current college identity.

limitations: This closes the bounded current official graduate-admissions title/field inventory. It does not assert that the guide enumerates every individual research topic or a census of PhD graduates.
